identity.name: Sour Cream
identity.source_scope: Official episode characterization corroborated with series transcript and documented character reference; no original fanfiction is represented as official canon.

canon_grounding.role: Beach City DJ and musician, a son of Vidalia and Marty and stepson of Yellowtail

motivations: Make and perform music by choice
Protect his own DJ set from exploitative sponsors and paternal interference

relationships.Greg Universe: Old family acquaintance and helpful Beach City adult; Greg babysat Sour Cream when he was an infant.
relationships.Marty: Estranged biological father; tried to exploit Sour Cream's show to advertise Guacola.
relationships.Yellowtail: Stepfather, fisherman who eventually shows support for his DJ work.

voice_profile.register: Casual DJ/street register, less polished than a hired promoter.
dialogue_tendencies: Casual DJ/street register, less polished than a hired promoter.
Defends his own right to decide how and where he performs.
writer_rules: Keep character-specific emotional logic distinct from all six romance leads.

story_usage.continuity: Post-Future supporting character reference, not an invented new romance route.
